activity_summary: At the Jackdaw, dinner was sixpence. You told Burbage they have a god in a lion's skin and that he shall have a looking-glass. You said the king has given up the crown, sends for a glass, looks, and breaks it. He asked for it, and you said when you have written how he gets there. Heminges said a glass is four shillings and that he will break one every time. He named no Rose sum. Garnish gave Kemp's interest as six days, nineteen lines, and a noise like a goose. Kemp was not there. You said he has not seen the book. You did not buy the glass.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Told the glass, refused to buy it tonight, and kept the book unshown.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Asked for the break, and closed his hand as on a handle.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Priced the glass at four shillings, and stayed gloomy about giants without naming a Rose sum.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Gave six days as nineteen lines, and a noise like a goose, and would not read them aloud.

entities.name: Agnes Tipping
entities.context: Set dinner at sixpence, and sent the rest of the talk home.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: When I've written how he gets there.
